description: Paginated playlist contents — cursor/nextCursor/hasMore, same row shape as channel-videos. Flat 2 credits/page. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Leave empty for the first page; then pass the nextCursor value returned in the previous response.

fast.description: Set true to use YouTube RSS for faster results with less detailed metadata. Leave false when viewCount/duration quality matters.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 50, max 500). Flat 2 credits per call.

url.description: YouTube playlist URL, e.g. https://youtube.com/playlist?list=ID. The URL platform must match this endpoint's platform. Do not pass cross-platform URLs, e.g. YouTube to TikTok, Instagram to Facebook, LinkedIn to X/Twitter, or Pinterest to Rumble.

name: youtube_playlist_videos
title: YouTube Playlist Videos
